title: Personalized news is currently broken.
body:
Most apps today just echo what you already believe. They feed you more of the same, creating a loop that narrows your perspective rather than expanding it. That is the opposite of what news should do.

At Headlinne, we are building something different. We want to use AI to filter out the noise, not the nuance. Our roadmap is focused on a simple goal: giving you the full picture without forcing you to dig for it. It means surfacing stories that challenge your assumptions while respecting your time.

We believe the future of news isn't about algorithmic echo chambers. It is about giving you control over what you see, how you see it, and why it matters to your daily life. We are working on tools that help you understand complex topics faster, without losing the accuracy that good journalism requires.
cta: You can see what we are building and try it for yourself at HEADLINNE.com.
